title: 第1章 穿成惨死的反派奸相
slug: 读心后疯批暴君决定洗白
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“宋云初，你这卑鄙无耻的狗贼！就该遭五雷轰顶，不得好死！”

听着耳畔高亢的谩骂，宋云初脚下的步伐一顿，眉头轻微跳动了一下。

来到这书中世界不过十天，听人骂她“狗贼”都听了有几十遍。

前头不远便是御书房，宋云初正要叫人把身后咒骂她的武将先拖走，身旁的红衣侍女已经身影一晃来到了男人面前，一脚踢向那人的心口。

“辱骂相爷不可饶恕，将你就地斩杀都不为过，来人！”

女子一声令下，多名侍卫汇聚过来，六七把长剑瞬间抵在了男人的脖颈处。

宋云初连忙出声拦下，“慢着！”

红衣女子转过头，面带不解，“相爷要留此人性命？”

宋云初道：“将他暂且收押就好，本相还有话要问他。”

侍卫们将男人拖了下去。而那人在被拖行时仍赤红着双眼破口大骂：“狗贼，你尽管杀了我，我做鬼都不会放过你！”

宋云初暗自叹息一声，才转过身，便听身后的两名属下私语着——

“这人真是狗嘴里吐不出象牙。”

“相爷要问话，此人的舌头还得留着。给他上水刑和钉刑，让他尝尝生不如死的滋味。”

宋云初面色微变，连忙转头又嘱咐道：“不必用刑，你把人看住了就成！”

对面的二人怔了怔，随即齐声应道：“是。”

那人这般放肆，相爷竟要免了他的刑罚。莫非是他有什么过人之处？

宋云初将属下们疑惑却又不敢多问的神色看在眼中，面无表情地转头走开。

也不怪他们吃惊，她这副身体的原主是当朝右丞相，女扮男装入朝为官，平日里心黑手毒，缺德得很。

十天前的夜里，她在小说软件上手滑点开了这本《惹上邪王，爱妃你别逃》，一眼就瞄到简介上角色那一栏里，有个和她同名的人物，鬼使神差地就点了进去。

这是一本标签为追妻火葬场的古早虐恋文。

男主对女主虐身又虐心，看得让人头疼，尤其当她看到与她同名的反派宋相被皇帝以谋逆罪革职流放，之后被男主逸王带人乱箭射死的剧情时，心中的愤怒到达了顶峰。

这有勇有谋的大反派，怎么就死在了她最唾弃的男主手上？

为了发泄心中的不满，她这个看书一向懒得发书评的人，给这本书发了数不清的吐槽。

而原文作者在她的最后一条书评底下回复：亲，要不笔给你，你来写？

一觉醒来后，她成了书中的宋相。

"Song Yunchu, you despicable and shameless thief! You deserve to be struck by five thunders and die a good death!"

Listening to the high-pitched curses in his ears, Song Yunchu paused in his steps and his brows twitched slightly.

She had only been in this world for ten days, and she had been called a "dog thief" dozens of times.

Not far ahead was the imperial study room. Song Yunchu was about to ask someone to drag away the general who was cursing her behind him. The maid in red beside him had already appeared in front of the man and kicked him in the heart.

"Insulting the Prime Minister is unforgivable. I'll kill you on the spot. Come on!"

The woman gave an order, and several guards gathered over, and six or seven long swords were instantly pressed against the man's neck.

Song Yunchu quickly stopped him, "Wait a minute!"

The woman in red turned her head, with a puzzled expression on her face, "Does the prime minister want to keep this person alive?"

Song Yunchu said: "Just take him into custody temporarily. I still have something to ask him about the truth."

The guards dragged the man down.While being dragged away, the man still yelled with red eyes: "You thief, even if you kill me, I will never let you go!"

Song Yunchu sighed secretly, turned around, and heard the two subordinates behind him whispering——

"This man is really like a dog that can't spit out ivory."

"If the prime minister wants to question him, he must still have his tongue. Waterboard and crucify him, and let him taste life worse than death."

Song Yunchu's expression changed slightly, and he quickly turned around and said: "There is no need to torture, just keep the person under control!"

The two people on the opposite side were stunned, and then responded in unison: "Yes."

The man was so presumptuous that the prime minister actually wanted to exempt him from punishment.Could it be that there is something special about him?

Song Yunchu saw the confused looks in his subordinates' eyes but didn't dare to ask any more questions, turned his head and walked away expressionlessly.

It's no wonder they were surprised. The original owner of her body was the Prime Minister of the current Dynasty. She disguised herself as a man and entered the court as an official. She was usually very evil and evil.

Ten days ago at night, she opened the book "Don't Run Away with the Evil King, Beloved Concubine" on the novel software. She glanced at the character column on the introduction and saw a character with the same name as her. She clicked on it by accident.

This is an ancient sadomasochistic novel labeled Chasing Wife Crematorium.

The male protagonist was physically and mentally abusive to the female protagonist, which was a headache to watch, especially when she saw the plot in which the villain Song Xiang, who had the same name as her, was dismissed and exiled by the emperor for treason, and was later shot to death by random arrows led by the male protagonist King Yi, the anger in her heart reached its peak.

Why did this brave and strategic villain die at the hands of the male protagonist she despised the most?

In order to vent her dissatisfaction, she, who never bothers to post reviews when reading books, posted countless complaints about this book.

The original author replied under her last book review: Dear, how about I give you the pen and you write it?

After waking up, she became Prime Minister Song in the book.
